big_case.notes: Pro se Rule 20 mandamus petition (No. 25-1315) asking the Court to let the petitioner act as a celebrity's 'next friend' in a dismissed private civil suit the Eighth Circuit affirmed; the petition alleges a government conspiracy, CIA mind control and directed-energy weapons. Every respondent, the Solicitor General included, waived response; single distribution; one-line denial on the long-conference order list with no noted dissent. No doctrinal question, no governmental interest, no downstream effect. Disclosure: the blinded prediction.json carries big_case_score, so I saw each candidate's number while reading the file; my read rests on the petition text and docket shape and would be the same without them.
